meta.title: DSH Session Memory
meta.description: DSH-only persisted source-turn recall: plugin-owned SQLite, entity ranking/global-project dedup, local/remote Jev, history reads/stats/backfill and Obsidian.

config.title: DSH Session Memory configuration
config.summary: Recall defaults, local/remote Jev and Obsidian export settings.
config.intro: Changes are staged until Save. Saving applies live and cancels outstanding memory work; it does not start a model or write a note.
config.recall.limit.hint: Integer 1–50, default 20. Filters/dedup never refill. Call arguments can set a different limit.
config.jev.enabled.hint: Default off. Recall judges complete visible source turns before output truncation; model failures are explicitly unavailable and configuration errors throw.
config.jev.model.hint: Explicit local or remote System One model, default nimble.
config.jev.baseURL.hint: HTTP(S) API root, without embedded credentials, query, hash or redirects. Remote connections send the question and selected source-turn text to this server.
config.jev.apiKeyEnv.hint: Host variable name, never the secret itself. Required for remote Jev; must be populated on the Host. Blank restores inheritance.
config.jev.manageOllama.hint: Explicit permission to start local Ollama and pull this model. Never shuts down a pre-existing service.
config.jev.contextWindow.hint: Integer 1024–1048576. Required for enabled unmanaged Jev; optional cap when managed. Blank restores inherited value.
config.obsidian.enabled.hint: Every completed recall/audit page creates a private Markdown note. External vault sync may distribute history.
config.obsidian.vaultPath.hint: Existing absolute Host directory, required when enabled. No folders are created. Blank restores inherited value.
config.refused: Save refused or configuration changed elsewhere. Draft kept; discard to read current values before retrying.
config.readOnly: Configuration is read-only in this deployment.
config.unavailable: Configuration is not available. Enable the plugin and reload the profile/browser if needed.
